text_block_list.text:
I brought Phalaenopsis, who had injured 
herself, 
to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—I will see to the treatment now. 
Wait here.
choice_data_list: Wait, you can treat it yourself?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Injuries go hand in hand with martial arts 
training. 
I am accustomed to it. Worry not.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Mm, it is nothing serious after all. 
Apply this here... and there.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
All done. 
Let us return to training.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Mm. An injury of this degree 
is no reason to halt my steps.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I am otherwise in perfect health. 
If my body can move, why should I not 
forge ahead?
choice_data_list:
No, if you're thinking about the future, 
you should rest.

No, thinking of what lies ahead, you 
really should rest.
Well... I suppose you have a point.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I am otherwise in perfect health. 
If my body can move, why should I not 
forge ahead?
choice_data_list:
No, if you're thinking about the future, 
you should rest.

No, if we're thinking about the future, 
you should rest.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hoh? 
You truly are a worrywart, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Still, well... I suppose you are right. 
I can understand your concern for the 
future.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Then for now, 
I shall place myself in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Mm. Shall we head outside, then?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, I miscalculated... 
Good grief... how pathetic of me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Mm, there seems to be no issue. 
The treatment appears to have done its 
work.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Even so, complacency is our enemy. 
Without rushing, let us build upon this, 
step by step.
